تستمدون (form X)
# تَسْتَمِدُّونَ (tastamiddūna) /tas.ta.mid.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَمَدَّ (istamadda)
# تُسْتَمَدُّونَ (tustamaddūna) /tus.ta.mad.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَمَدَّ (istamadda)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
